newsitem.title: USA: United Auto Group names Robert Nelson CFO.
newsitem.headline: United Auto Group names Robert Nelson CFO.

text.p: United Auto Group Inc said Wednesday it had named Robert Nelson as chief financial officer, succeeding Arthur Rawl, who resigned.

Nelson has been vice chairman of Atlantic Auto Finance Corp, the company's automobile finance company, since March 1996 and a director of the company since January 1996. He is also an officer and director of Trace International Holdings Inc.
It said Rawl participated in United Auto's initial public stock offering in November.
